methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The purpose of this work is to modify the fuel supply systems for a TPP switching from solid, liquid, and gas fuel to high-potential CWSP fuels.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: No EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised; the paper evaluates fuel-system modification and techno-economic switching costs.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Dmitrienko and Strizhak (2018) considered three power-generating facilities ﬁred by various types of fuel.

stage1.notes: Energy-performance wording refers to fuel characteristics and cost comparison, not an EnPI/EnB baseline or normalisation model.
